_comment: The alpha checklist (tools/oxide/encounters/alpha.py) places each item of docs/oxide/ingame-checklist.md in the zone of the first place, town or trainer its text names, else 'anywhere'. These override that, by the item's key (its bold title, else its first eight words): a zone, 'zone|split' for a later visit, or 'anywhere'. test_alpha fails on a key that no longer matches an item.
